_comment: RU routing pipeline - Xray lite example. Placeholder tokens {{VERSION}} and {{CDN_BASE}} are substituted at build time by ru_routing.render.render_examples. node-example is a documented placeholder outbound tag: replace its address/credentials with a real inter-node deployment before use.
_default_outbound_comment: 5. Unmatched traffic to PROXY. Xray uses the first entry of 'outbounds' as the default when no routing rule matches, so 'proxy' is declared first here: lite protects a client behind a VPN, so unrecognized destinations must not silently bypass the tunnel.

outbounds._comment: Default outbound (first entry). Replace with the real upstream/VPN outbound (vless, vmess, trojan, ...) for your deployment.
PLACEHOLDER outbound tag for deployment-specific inter-node routing. Replace address/credentials before deployment. Not used by the lite policy; kept for interface parity with the server example.

rules._comment: 1. Private/local traffic to DIRECT via Xray's built-in geoip:private, not custom geodata.
2. spy category to BLOCK (lite's only default-blocked thematic category). spy is sourced from runetfreedom/russia-v2ray-rules-dat (domain-only; no CIDR source), so there is no corresponding IP rule.
3. Explicit Russian blocked domains/IPs to PROXY (prevents unsafe DIRECT matches).
3. Explicit Russian blocked CIDRs to PROXY.
4. Trusted RU and Russia-only traffic to DIRECT.
